attribution.terrain_and_building_heights: Derived from LiDAR DTM/DBM PAT 2014 / 2018, Provincia Autonoma di Trento - Servizio Geologico, CC BY 4.0. Cropped, subsampled, translated to local coordinates; building roof heights summarized and volumes approximated.
attribution.orthophoto: Comune di Trento, Ortofoto 2024, flight 28-29 August 2024, CC0 1.0 Universal. Resampled WMS extract used for geographic reference and approximate roof-envelope tracing.

note: A 200 x 300 m survey blockout, not a final playable boundary. Rectangular modules approximate roof envelopes inspected in the 2024 municipal orthophoto and PAT DBM. These are not cadastral footprints or architectural measurements. Courtyard gaps are retained. Heights summarize mixed-date roof surfaces; base levels are buried construction assumptions. The bridge slab thickness is assumed. No interiors, openings, stairs, collision or CS2 entities are authored.
